name: Foldwing · Gremlet #25
description:
A paper crane folded with a wish inside. It flaps a little stiffly.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Foldwing in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
